Need to establish an Agriculture University in Shahjahanpur district, 

Uttar Pradesh-Laid

श्री अरुण कुमार सागर (शाहजहाँपुर) : मेरे संसदीय क्षेत्र शाहजहांपुर, जो एक अनुसूचित बाहुल्य क्षेत्र है, में गन्ना, गेहूं, धान और आलू की प्रमुख रूप से खेती होती है और फलों में आम व अमरूद की भी काफी उपज है । 

मुझे क्षेत्र में भ्रमण के दौरान विगत काफी समय से स्थानीय लोग शाहजहांपुर जनपद में कृषि विश्वविद्यालय की स्थापना कराए जाने हेतु अनुरोध कर रहे हैं । यह सही है कि यहाँ पर कृषि विश्वविद्यालय की स्थापना किए जाने से युवाओं को कृषि की बारीकियां मालूम हो सकेंगी और वे कौशलयुक्त बन सकेंगे और साथ ही चूँकि, बरेली मंडल में कहीं भी कृषि विश्वविद्यालय नहीं है, इसलिए शाहजहांपुर के निकटवर्ती कृषि प्रधान जिलों को भी इसका भरपूर लाभ मिल सकेगा । 

अत: मेरा सरकार से अनुरोध है कि वह शाहजहांपुर जनपद के पुवायां विधानसभा क्षेत्र के अंतर्गत खुटार, जो गन्ना एवं धान की बंपर उपज के लिए पहचाने जाते हैं, में एक कृषि विश्वविद्यालय स्थापित किए जाने हेतु सकारात्मक कदम उठाए ।
records.ls|LS18_S4_1944:
Need for adequate funds for beautification and maintenance of Barabati Fort of Cuttack in Odisha-Laid

SHRI BHARTRUHARI MAHTAB (CUTTACK): Barabati Fort of Cuttack, the citadel of Utkal for hundreds of years is lying neglected. It was constructed 1000 years back in the Eleventh Century and has been witnessed to many upheavals in history. Abul Fazal has in Ain-i-Akbari stated Gajapati King Mukunda Deva reconstructed Barabati Fort which was nine-storied palace. Though it is a protected monument and ASI is in possession yet not much steps are being taken to restore it and develop it into a tourist spot. The gorge that surrounds the Fort is in utter neglect. The Interpretation Centre, newly constructed in the Fort area has not been opened. I urge upon the Government to grant adequate funds for beautification, maintenance of the Fort area and to desilt the gorge along with construction of the stone- walling of the gorge that encircles the Fort at the earliest to protect it from further decay.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1945:
Need to formulate policies for sustainable repurposing of opencast mine voids with fly ash-Laid

SHRIMATI SANGEETA KUMARI SINGH DEO (BOLANGIR): I would like to highlight one significant issue surrounding open-cast mine voids and their potential for repurposing. Neglected mine voids, left unmanaged by mining companies, pose significant social, environmental, and governance challenges. These voids deprive communities of land that could be utilized for livelihood opportunities or public welfare. A viable solution lies in repurposing these voids for fly ash disposal. Odisha, with approximately 20 GW of operational coal-based thermal power plants and an additional 10 GW in the pipeline, faces a steep increase in coal consumption?from 150 MMT to 220 MMT annually?leading to a surge in ash generation from 55 MMT to 85 MMT per year. The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change mandates 100% ash utilization, yet limited avenues for sustainable use create compliance challenges, with penalties of ₹1,000 per metric ton potentially increasing power costs. Repurposing open-cast mine voids offers a dual benefit: effective ash utilization and development of renewable energy infrastructure, aiding compliance with Renewable Generation Obligations (RGO) set by the Ministry of Power. I urge the Government to formulate policies for the sustainable repurposing of mine voids, enabling states like Odisha to manage ash effectively while fostering renewable energy development for a sustainable energy future.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1946:
Need to make a comprehensive policy to address death and injuries caused due to snakebite-Laid

SHRI RAMASAHAYAM RAGHURAM REDDY (KHAMMAM): I would like to highlight the urgent and under-addressed public health crisis of snakebite envenomation, which disproportionately affects rural and vulnerable communities. India accounts for nearly 60% of global snakebite deaths, with 58,000 fatalities and 200,000 disabilities annually, as per WHO. Rural areas like Telangana, Bihar, Odisha, and Tamil Nadu face acute challenges, including limited access to healthcare, poor emergency infrastructure, and antivenom shortages. Victims, primarily farmers and labourers, suffer economic losses, perpetuating poverty. Key actions include equipping healthcare centres with antivenom and trained personnel, improving transportation, boosting antivenom production, and conducting community awareness programs. A National Action Plan aligned with WHO?s strategy and a dedicated budget are essential. Hence, I request the Hon?ble Minister for Health and family welfare to initiate a Comprehensive data collection through a national registry to guide effective policy-making. Let us prioritize this issue to save lives and support vulnerable families.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1947:
Need to release funds for construction of ROB at Level Crossing No. 265 in Jhunjhunu city, Rajasthan-Laid

श्री बृजेन्द्र सिंह ओला (झुन्झुनू) : मैं सरकार का ध्यान एक महत्त्वपूर्ण विषय की ओर ध्यान दिलाना चाहता हूं । मेरे संसदीय क्षेत्र अंतर्गत झुंझुनूं शहर से स्टेट हाइवे-8 गुजर रहा है । इस स्टेट हाइवे पर रेलवे क्रॉसिंग नंबर 265 स्थित है । इस रेलवे क्रॉसिंग 265 पर रेलवे और राजस्थान सरकार द्वारा संयुक्त रूप से आरओबी (rob) का निर्माण कार्य शुरु किया गया था लेकिन रेलवे द्वारा अपने हिस्से का बजट नहीं देने के कारण यह कार्य अभी रुका हुआ है जिससे आमजन को आने जाने में काफी समस्याओं का सामना करना पड़ रहा है । इसलिए क्षेत्रवासियों की परेशानियों को देखते हुए माननीय रेल मंत्री जी से निवेदन है कि वो रेलवे क्रॉसिंग नंबर 265 पर निर्माणाधीन कार्य के लिए रेलवे के हिस्से का बजट अतिशीघ्र जारी करने की कृपा करें जिससे यह कार्य पुनः शुरु हो सके और क्षेत्रवासियों को हो रही परेशानी से उनको निजात मिल सके ।
records.ls|LS18_S4_1948:
Need to address the problems faced by labourers under Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme-Laid

श्री हरीश चंद्र मीना (टोंक-सवाई माधोपुर) : मैं सरकार का ध्यान देश एवं विशेषकर राजस्थान के ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में काम कर रहे मनरेगा मजदूरों की समस्याओं की ओर आकर्षित करना चाहता हूं । महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी अधिनियम (मनरेगा) का उद्देश्य ग्रामीण क्षेत्रों में बेरोजगारी को कम करना और गरीबों को रोजगार का अधिकार देना है । लेकिन इस योजना के क्रियान्वयन में अनेक गंभीर समस्याएं सामने आ रही हैं । आज मजदूरों को उनका मेहनताना समय पर नहीं मिल रहा है। कई राज्यों में मजदूरी के भुगतान में महीनों की देरी हो रही है । मजदूरों को उनके श्रम का उचित मूल्य समय पर न मिलना, उनके परिवारों की आजीविका पर भारी असर डाल रहा है । इस योजना में भ्रष्टाचार एक बड़ी चुनौती बनकर उभरा है । बिचौलिए और स्थानीय अधिकारी मजदूरों का हक मार रहे हैं । फर्जी जॉब कार्ड बनाकर मजदूरों के नाम पर धन का गबन किया जा रहा है । मजदूरी की दरें आज भी कई जगहों पर न्यूनतम मजदूरी से कम हैं । इसके अलावा, काम के लिए जरूरी औजार, पानी, और स्वास्थ्य सेवाएं भी पर्याप्त नहीं हैं । मनरेगा सिर्फ एक योजना नहीं है, यह गरीब ग्रामीणों के लिए जीवनरेखा है । सरकार को इस दिशा में तत्काल कदम उठाने की आवश्यकता है ।
records.ls|LS18_S4_1949:
Need to increase allocation under MPLAD Scheme-Laid

SHRI BENNY BEHANAN (CHALAKUDY): The MPLADS allocation has remained stagnant despite a significant rise in inflation and cost index over the years. This has made the current funds inadequate to meet the growing development needs of our constituencies. Many constituencies, including Chalakudy Parliamentary Constituency, comprise more than seven Assembly segments, making it challenging to equitably allocate resources, leaving critical needs unmet. Moreover, the scope of MPLADS projects has expanded to include infrastructure, education, healthcare, and disaster management, further straining the limited allocation. Increasing MPLADS funds is crucial for ensuring faster and inclusive development, particularly in geographically vast and socio-economically disadvantaged regions. MPLADS also strengthens the bond between MPs and their constituents by addressing local issues effectively. I urge the Government to immediately revise and increase the MPLADS allocation, considering the rising cost index and expanded responsibilities, to ensure equitable and sustainable development.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1950:
Regarding wild boars menace in various districts of Tamil Nadu-Laid

SHRI B. MANICKAM TAGORE (VIRUDHUNAGAR): I would like to bring attention of the Government towards the critical issue of the wild boar menace in Tamil Nadu?s agricultural regions, specifically in Ramanathapuram, Sivagangai, and Virudhunagar districts, and to draw a parallel with a similar situation in Uttarakhand. The unchecked overpopulation of wild boars outside forest areas is wreaking havoc on crops and threatening the safety of human lives and property. Farmers in these districts are suffering enormous financial losses, with reports of extensive damage to crops like paddy, sugarcane, and groundnuts, especially during harvest seasons. In Uttarakhand, the Forest Department has already proposed to the Centre to declare wild boars as vermin under Section 62 of the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972. This declaration would allow the culling of wild boars without permission, aiming to mitigate the damage caused to agriculture and protect human lives. I urge the Minister of Environment, Forest and Climate Change to consider implementing a similar solution for Tamil Nadu and other affected regions, allowing farmers to deal with this growing menace effectively. I request immediate intervention from the Government to provide compensation to farmers who have suffered due to the wild boar damage and implement protective measures such as fencing or relocation strategies to safeguard their livelihoods.

श्री राजीव राय (घोसी) : केंद्र सरकार द्वारा देश के युवाओं को दिए जाने वाले रोजगार की समग्र स्थिति अपने ऐतिहासिक निचले स्तर पर है । वास्तव में रोजगार से संबंधित सरकार द्वारा कुछ चौंकाने वाले निर्णय रिपोर्ट किए जा रहे हैं, जो अत्यंत चिंता का विषय हैं । वर्ष 2021 में मिलिट्री इंजीनियरिंग सर्विसेज (रक्षा मंत्रालय) द्वारा बैरक स्टोर सुपरवाइजर एवं ड्राफ्ट्समैन पद की संयुक्त वैकेंसी आयी थी, जिसकी परीक्षा और दस्तावेज सत्यापन का कार्य दिसंबर 2021 में पूर्ण हो गया था । 

आरटीआई के जवाब में यह बताया गया कि दस्तावेज सत्यापन के आठ सप्ताह के बाद नियुक्ति जारी कर दी जाएगी । किंतु हैरानी की बात यह है कि इस परीक्षा की सारी प्रक्रिया के विवाद रहित होते हुए भी दस्तावेज सत्यापन के तीन वर्ष छह माह से अधिक का समय बीत जाने के उपरांत आज तक नियुक्ति जारी नहीं की गई । यहाँ तक कि विभाग के द्वारा इस संबंध में आफिशियल वेबसाइट पर कोई सूचना भी जारी नहीं की गई । विभाग एवं मंत्रालय के इस रवैये से सभी अभ्यर्थी दिग्भ्रमित एवं अंधकारमय भविष्य को लेकर चिंतित एवं कुंठित हैं । अत: रक्षा मंत्री जी से निवेदन है कि यथोचित कार्रवाई करने का निर्देश जारी करें ताकि इन युवाओं का भविष्य सुरक्षित हो सके ।
records.ls|LS18_S4_1952:
Regarding damage to coconut plants due to attack of black headed  

caterpillars in Tirupattur and Tiruvannamalai districts in Tamil Nadu-Laid

SHRI C. N. ANNADURAI (TIRUVANNAMALAI): I wish to draw kind attention of Union Government of India towards the attack of Black Headed Caterpillar causing huge damage to coconut plants in Tirupattur & Tiruvannamalai District which comes under my Parliamentary Constituency, Tiruvannamalai, Tamil Nadu. Needless to say that coconut is the mainstay of the farmers living in Tirupattur & Tiruvannamalai District. Coconut is cultivated in the area covering 10,600 hectares of land, by 5800 farmers, thereby producing 954 lakhs nuts per year only in Tirupattur District. It is due to the above mention pest attack the coconut production is being drastically reduced. Therefore, I request Hon?ble Union Minister for Agriculture and Farmers Welfare to take necessary action to regulate the pest attack and also to give adequate compensation to the farmers at the earliest.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1953:
Need to open a Kendriya Vidyalaya in Kallakurichi Parliamentary Constituency, Tamil Nadu-Laid

SHRI MALAIYARASAN D. (KALLAKURICHI): Kallakurichi Lok Sabha Constituency is one of the 39 Lok Sabha constituencies in Tamil Nadu . It is unfortunate that this constituency does not have even a single Kendriya Vidyalaya so far. The total tribal population in Tamil Nadu is about 8 Lakh. Out of this, nearly 25% ie., 2 Lakh tribal people live in my Kallakurichi Parliamentary Constituency. They are traditional inhabitants of Kalvarayan Hills, Chinna Kalvarayan Hills, Shervaroys Hills and Pachamalai Hills of the Eastern Ghats. More than 60 per cent of the tribal people are living below poverty line. Article 46 of the Constitution requires the State to promote with special care, the educational and economic interests of the weaker sections of the people and in particular the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes. To improve the literacy rate and educational standards of the tribal students especially the girls, Government of Tamil Nadu is running many schools. In order to provide quality CBSE system of education and to make tribal students match with the students in cities and towns, they require Kendriya Vidyalayas. Therefore, I urge upon the Union Minister of Education to take necessary steps for opening of a Kendriya Vidyalaya in my Kallakurichi Parliamentary Constituency.

श्री दिलेश्वर कामैत (सुपौल) : मेरे संसदीय क्षेत्र सुपौल जिला अंतर्गत निर्मली प्रखंड के कुनौली बाजार नेपाल सीमा के समीप अवस्थित है । नेपाल से आने वाली जीता धार एवं खांडो नदी भारत नेपाल सीमा के NO MAN?S LAND से होकर बिहार प्रदेश के सुपौल जिला के कुनौली पंचायत में प्रवेश करती है । उक्त दोनों नदिया अपने पुराने मार्ग को छोड़कर कुनौली पंचायत के कृषि योग्य भूमि एवं बाजार को प्रभावित करते हुए बहने लगी है जिससे सटे हुए कुनौली पंचायत, कमालपुर एवं डागमारा पंचायत के समग्र क्षेत्र को बाढ़ अवधि में बुरी तरह प्रभावित करती है जिससे जनजीवन एवं जानमाल को हर वर्ष काफी क्षति होती है I भीषण तबाही एवं नुकसान को बचाने हेतु बिहार सरकार के जल संसाधन विभाग द्वारा नदी की पुरानी धारा को पुनर्जीवित करने हेतु डी पी आर तैयार कर भारत सरकार के केंद्रीय जल आयोग को समर्पित किया जा चुका है । केंद्रीय जल आयोग, भारत सरकार के द्वारा इस योजना की स्वीकृति के लिए नेपाल सरकार का एन ओ सी अपेक्षित है । मैं सदन के माध्यम से भारत सरकार से आग्रह करता हूँ कि जनहित में अतिशीघ्र नेपाल सरकार से एन ओ सी उपलब्ध कराया जाय जिससे उक्त परियोजना का कार्य यथाशीघ्र शुरू किया जा सके ।
records.ls|LS18_S4_1955:
Need to expedite construction of ROBs/RUBs in Machilipatnam and 

Vijayawada Divisions of South Central Railway in Andhra Pradesh-Laid

SHRI BALASHOWRY VALLABHANENI (MACHILIPATNAM): Railways taken up removing all Level Crossings as a challenge and has been able to make a considerable progress in constructing ROBs/RUBs in the country. But, it is a fact that increasing traffic at LCs where earlier traffic used to be at manageable level now becoming unmanageable and become hurdles for seamless traffic. There are a few of such LCs fall in Machilipatnam and Vijayawada Division of SCR. SSE/P.Way/MTM, Machilipatnam, Vijayawada Division of SCR, after detailed review, found LC NOs. 09 (Ramavarappadu Gate), 12 (Gudlavalleru College Gate), 14 (Nidamanuru Gate), 16 (Gudalli Gate), 20 (Uppaluru Gate), 32 (Pedana Main Gaate), 38 (Chilakalapudi Gate), 43 (Medical College Gate), 44 (Gilkaladindi Gate) & 51(KTR College Gate) needs to be provided with ROBs. These fall under GDV-MTM Stations and Ramavarappadu and Gudivada Stations. ​Hence, I request Hon. Minister of Railways to take up these ROBs as they are very important for smooth flow of traffic early.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1956:
Need to provide compensation for land acquired for Green Field Highway along NH 744 in Kollam Parliamentary Constituency, Kerala-Laid

SHRI N. K. PREMACHANDRAN (KOLLAM): Land acquisition for Green Field Highway along NH 744 in my Parliamentary Constituency Kollam is standstill. The land acquisition process is not progressing. The 3A notification with regard to certain villages was expired. The construction and transaction of land were become idle due to the notification. The compensation for land acquisition is not yet released due to the lack of funds. There is administrative delay between Central Government and Government of Kerala regarding exemption of GST and royalty. Kerala Government decided to give exemption. It is reliably learnt that the Union Government has not sanctioned the project till date and no final decision is taken regarding disbursement of compensation. It is highly necessary to disburse the compensation at the earliest.

Statement regarding developments pertaining to deportation of Indians citizens from USA 

DR. SUBRAHMANYAM JAISHANKAR: Hon. Speaker, Sir, I rise to apprise the House of certain developments pertaining to deportation of Indians from the USA.

Sir, hon. Members are aware that people-to-people exchanges constitute the bedrock of our deepening ties with the United States. Indeed, more than any other relationship, mobility and migration has had a key role to play in enhancing its quality.

The House would also share the view of the Government that it is in our collective interest to encourage legal mobility and discourage illegal movement. In fact, illegal mobility and migration has many other associated activities, also of an illegal nature. Moreover, those of our citizens who are inveigled into illegal movement themselves become prey to other crimes. ? (Interruptions) They are trapped into both moving and working under inhumane conditions. Members are aware that unfortunately there have been even fatalities in the course of such illegal migration. Those who have returned have also testified to their harrowing experiences.

Mr. Speaker, Sir, it is the obligation of all nations to take back their nationals, if they are found to be living illegally abroad. This is naturally subject to an unambiguous verification of their nationality. ? (Interruptions) This is not a policy applicable to any specific country, nor indeed one only practised by India. It is a general accepted principle in international relations.

Sir, hon. Members would be aware that the process of deportation is not a new one, I repeat, the process of deportation is not a new one and has been ongoing for several years. ? है । माननीय प्रधानमंत्री श्री नरेंद्र मोदी जी ने पूर्वोत्तर को हमेशा से प्राथमिकता दी है और वहां के लोगों को यह विश्वास दिलाया कि विकास के लिए आंदोलन या विवाद की नहीं बल्कि सहयोग और परिश्रम की जरुरत है । मोदी जी के नेतृत्व में हमने पिछले 5 वर्षों में विभिन्न संगठनों के साथ 12 ऐतिहासिक समझौते किये हैं, जिनके कारण आज पूर्वोत्तर के बड़े हिस्से में शांति की स्थापना हुई है । 2014 में मोदी सरकार आने के बाद असम में हिंसक घटनाओं में 87% की कमी आई है । मोदी सरकार ने पूर्वोत्तर भारत के विकास के लिए वर्ष 2014-24 तक 4 लाख करोड़ रू. से भी अधिक की राशि खर्च की है । मेरा केंद्र सरकार से अनुरोध है कि पूर्वोत्तर क्षेत्र में उग्रवादी संगठनों के साथ हमारी सरकार द्वारा किये गए ऐतिहासिक समझौतों को समयबद्ध तरीके से क्रियान्वित किया जाए और स्थायी शान्ति स्थापित करने की दिशा में और भी ठोस कदम उठाये जाएँ ।
records.ls|LS18_S4_1970:
Need to establish a Navodaya Vidyalaya in Beawar District, Rajasthan-Laid

श्रीमती महिमा कुमारी मेवाड़ (राजसमन्द) : आज के समय में माननीय प्रधानमंत्री मोदी जी के नेतृत्त्व में एजुकेशन के सुधार और क्वालिटी को और भी अच्छा करने के प्रयास किये जा रहे है । सभी बच्चों को आसानी से एजुकेशन मिल सके इसके लिए भी प्रयास हो रहे है और अभी के बजट में एजुकेशन अपनी भाषा में मिल सके इसके लिए प्रयास किये गए हैं जो स्वागत योग्य कदम है । मेरे संसदीय क्षेत्र राजसमन्द राजस्थान के अंतर्गत आने वाला ब्यावर जिला नवगठित जिला है जो अजमेर जिले से बना है । नया जिला बन जाने के बाद भी अभी तक ब्यावर जिले में नवोदय विद्यालय का निर्माण नहीं हो सका है । अभी बच्चों की पढाई के लिए नवोदय विद्यालय, नसीराबाद (अजमेर ) में ही है । अत: ब्यावर में नवोदय विद्यालय बन जाने से बच्चों को अच्छी शिक्षा मिल सकेगी और उनका भविष्य भी अच्छा होगा । अत: मैं सरकार से मांग करती हूँ कि ब्यावर जिले में नवोदय स्कूल जल्दी से जल्दी शुरू किया जाये ।
records.ls|LS18_S4_1971:
Need to establish sports stadium in North East Delhi Parliamentary Constituency-Laid

श्री मनोज तिवारी (उत्तर-पूर्व दिल्ली) : मैं सरकार का ध्यान उत्तर पूर्वी दिल्ली में खेल सुविधाओं की कमी की ओर आकर्षित करना चाहता हूँ । यह क्षेत्र घनी आबादी वाला है, जहाँ हजारों युवा खेलों में रुचि रखते हैं, लेकिन समर्पित खेल स्टेडियम और बुनियादी सुविधाओं के अभाव में वे अपनी प्रतिभा निखार नहीं पा रहे । इससे युवा नशे और असामाजिक गतिविधियों की ओर भी बढ़ रहे हैं । उत्तर पूर्वी दिल्ली में कोई समर्पित खेल स्टेडियम नहीं है, जिससे खिलाड़ियों को अभ्यास के लिए सही स्थान नहीं मिलता । प्रशिक्षण सुविधाओं के अभाव में स्थानीय खिलाड़ी अन्य जिलों या राज्यों की ओर रुख कर रहे हैं । खेल मैदानों की कमी के कारण युवाओं के पास सीमित अवसर हैं । क्षेत्र में एक या अधिक आधुनिक खेल स्टेडियमों का निर्माण किया जाए । स्थानीय खेल मैदानों को अपग्रेड कर कोचिंग, फ्लडलाइट और अन्य सुविधाएँ दी जाएँ । स्पोर्ट्स स्कॉलरशिप और प्रशिक्षण केंद्र स्थापित किए जाएँ । स्कूल-कॉलेज स्तर पर खेल सुविधाओं का विस्तार किया जाए । खेल क्षेत्र में रोजगार बढ़ाने के लिए कोचिंग और प्रबंधन पदों का सृजन किया जाए । अतः मैं सरकार से अनुरोध करता हूँ कि उत्तर पूर्वी दिल्ली में शीघ्र खेल स्टेडियमों का निर्माण कर युवाओं को राष्ट्रीय-अंतरराष्ट्रीय स्तर पर आगे बढ़ने का अवसर दिया जाए ।
records.ls|LS18_S4_1972:
Need for official recognition for celebration of Sant Shri Sevalal Maharaj Jayanthi on 15th February-Laid

SHRIMATI D. K. ARUNA (MAHBUBNAGAR): I would like to bring to the kind notice of the Government the need to declare and give official recognition and nationwide celebrations of Sant Shri Sevalal Maharaj Jayanthi on 15th February every year. In this regard, I would like to state that 12 crore Banjaras in the country have significantly contributed to the nation's welfare, especially during times when there were no roads and they pioneered transportation creating trade routes to carry essential goods and also helped Army during battles. Unfortunately, despite their sacrifices and contributions, the rich history of the Banjaras remain unrecognized in written records. At a time of socio-economic despair with Banjaras, Sant Shri Sevalal Maharaj emerged as a guiding light, blessed by Goddess Jagadamba who is callipered and a reformer, he dedicated his life as a social reformer, spiritual leader, pioneer, warrior and mentor to lead the Banjaras into a righteous path and today he is worshipped as a spiritual guru in the form of God with grand Bhog, Bhandaras conducted worldwide in his honour. States like Telangana, AP, Karnataka and Maharashtra have already officially recognized and celebrated his Jayanthi on 15th February every year and by recognizing his services at the national level, this would be an acknowledgement of his unparalleled social and humanitarian contributions in recognition of his invaluable services to the nation. Therefore, considering the deep sentiments of Banjaras national and worldwide, I humbly request the Hon'ble Minister of Social Justice and Empowerment to kindly declare and give official recognition and nationwide celebrations of Shri Sevalal Maharaj Jayanthi on 15th February every year.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1973:
Need to increase the number of beds in ESIC Hospital, Adityapur and establish an ESIC hospital in Moubhandar, Ghatshila in Jharkhand-Laid

श्री बिद्युत बरन महतो (जमशेदपुर) : इ.एस.आई.सी अस्पताल आदित्यपुर का (आईपी) लगभग 2 लाख है, जो यह स्पष्ट करता है कि यहां पर हर दिन बड़ी संख्या में श्रमिक इलाज के लिए आते हैं । यह आंकड़ा यह सिद्ध करता है कि अस्पताल में बेड की संख्या बहुत कम है और यह समस्या लगातार बढ़ती जा रही है । मेरे संसदीय क्षेत्र में घाटशिला अंतर्गत मुहभण्डार क्षेत्र में HCL की कॉपर माइंस, UCIL माइंस, राइस मिल और अन्य कई नए उद्योग स्थापित हो रहे हैं जिससे वहां कार्यरत श्रमिकों को चिकित्सा की कोई सुविधा नही है और यहाँ से श्रमिकों एवं उनके परिवारों को स्वास्थ्य सम्बंधित समस्याओं के निवारण हेतु एक-मात्र अस्पताल ESIC आदित्यपुर जाना पड़ता है जो कि लगभग 100 किमी से भी अधिक दूरी पर स्थित है l मेरा माननीय मंत्री जी से अनुरोध है कि इ.एस.आई.सी अस्पताल, आदित्यपुर में बेड्स की कम संख्या को देखते हुए ESIC अस्पताल में बेड्स की संख्या को बढ़ा दिया जाए,साथ ही ESIC अस्पताल की एक शाखा मुहभण्डार, घाटशिला में स्थापित करने की कृपा करें ।
records.ls|LS18_S4_1974:
Need for urgent repairing and maintenance of breakwater at Androth Island in Lakshadweep-Laid

SHRI HAMDULLAH SAYEED (LAKSHADWEEP): I would like to draw the attention of the Government to the urgent need for maintenance and repair of the breakwater at Androth Island, which is crucial for ensuring the safety and functionality of the island?s maritime infrastructure. Several essential works, including the de-silting of the main wharf area, the retrieval and placement of tetrapods, and the supply of granite stone boulders for backfilling, are pending for approval from the authorities. Despite estimates being submitted, the delay in approval and execution of these works is putting the infrastructure at risk. The tender process for casting 8T tetrapods is in progress, while the casting and placement of 8T tetrapods at the seaside of the breakwater await approval. These structures are critical for mitigating the impact of strong Hitting waves and protecting the breakwater. The maintenance of the IIF Wharf passenger shutter remains unfinished, affecting operations and connectivity. A major obstacle is the lack of a suitable crane. The retrieval and placement of 8T/12T tetrapods, awarded in 2023, have not begun due to the absence of a 100-ton capacity crane. The existing 30T crane is insufficient. I urge the Government to approve pending estimates, procure a high-capacity crane, and expedite the necessary work.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1975:
Need to expedite implementation of Jal Jeevan Mission in Kerala-Laid

SHRI BENNY BEHANAN (CHALAKUDY): I wish to draw the attention of the Government to the serious delays in the implementation of the Jal Jeevan Mission (JJM) in Kerala. The Mission, which aims to provide Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTCs) to all rural households, is facing hurdles due to fund shortages and non-disbursal of payments to contractors. This has significantly slowed down progress, affecting thousands of households. Moreover, roads dug up for JJM pipeline works remain unrestored, causing severe inconvenience to the public. Many panchayat roads are in a dilapidated state, posing safety hazards to commuters and residents. The delay in releasing payments has further stalled road restoration efforts. I urge the Government to immediately address the issue by releasing pending funds, ensuring timely payments to contractors, and directing authorities to restore affected roads at the earliest. The success of JJM depends on efficient execution, and any delay undermines the purpose of providing safe drinking water. I seek the intervention of the Hon?ble Minister to take urgent action in this regard.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1976:
Need to fill up the vacancies in National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC) and ensure its effective functionality-Laid

SHRI B. MANICKAM TAGORE (VIRUDHUNAGAR):The prolonged vacancies in the National Commission for Backward Classes (NCBC), a constitutional body that plays a vital role in safeguarding the rights of our backward classes. For over a year, the positions of Vice-Chairperson and two members of the NCBC have remained vacant, severely affecting its functioning. This is not just a procedural lapse; it is a direct violation of the promise made to uplift and protect the interests of the backward classes in our country. The NCBC's mandate includes making recommendations for the inclusion of communities in the list of backward classes, investigating and monitoring complaints of discrimination, and advising the Government on matters related to social justice. The absence of key members in this Commission has paralyzed its work, leaving the backward classes without a proper forum to address their grievances and seek justice. This is a matter of deep concern, as it reflects the government's indifference toward the welfare of the most marginalized sections of society. I urge the Government to immediately fill these vacancies and ensure that the NCBC can function effectively, as it is crucial for the social and economic advancement of backward classes. The time to act is now.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1977:
Regarding adverse impact on steel industries due to rise in prices of PNG in Mandi Gobindgarh, Punjab-Laid

DR. AMAR SINGH (FATEHGARH SAHIB): Mandi Gobindgarh is the Steel industry hub of north India. It is part of Shri Fatehgarh Sahib Constituency. Once a bustling centre of iron and steel industry it has been affected in the recent past due to faulty policies and unfavorable trade conditions. Majority of the units are MSMEs, yet they collectively give employment to thousands of people. At present, the owners of these Industries are protesting that PNG pipelines were laid and owners of re-rolling units had spent crores on installing gas machinery and over a period of time, companies started increasing the price of PNG, forcing the steel industries in Punjab to again use coal or to shut down, so as to compete with the states where fossil fuel was still being used. Therefore, Government should consider and revise the pricing so that the industry and environment both should not be impacted. I request the Government to depute senior officers to meet with the industry groups from Mandi Gobindgarh and offer the maximum policy relief possible.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1978:
Need to restore allocation of funds under various scholarship schemes meant for students belonging to marginalized communities-Laid

DR. SHASHI THAROOR (THIRUVANANTHAPURAM): I wish to draw the Union Government?s attention to the proposed drastic budget cuts to key scholarship programmes, which would severely impact marginalised students' access to higher education. The Union Budget 2025 proposes a 99.8% cut to the National Overseas Scholarship, reducing it from Rs. 6 crore in revised estimates (RE) 2024 to Rs. 0.01 crore in budget estimates (BE) 2025. Similarly, the National Fellowship and Scholarship for Higher Education of ST Students proposes a 99.99% reduction, from Rs. 240 crore in RE 2024 to Rs. 0.02 crore in BE 2025. Additionally, the Pre-Matric and Post-Matric Scholarships for Minorities are set to decrease by 72.4% and 69.9%, respectively according to the proposed Budget. Additionally, the Parliamentary Standing Committee on Social Justice and Empowerment has pointed out that no new schemes have been introduced to replace the Maulana Azad National Fellowship and the Padho Pardesh Interest Subsidy Scheme which were discontinued in 2022-23 due to overlaps with other government programs. I, therefore, urge the Ministers of Finance and other concerned Ministries to take immediate measures to restore funding for these crucial scholarships and ensure that financial constraints do not prevent students from disadvantaged backgrounds from accessing higher education.

श्रीमती कृष्णा देवी शिवशंकर पटेल (बांदा) : बुंदेलखंड का सारा क्षेत्र कृषि आधारित है । मैं बांदा चित्रकूट से चुन कर आती हूँ तथा वहाँ मुख्य रूप से चावल और गेहूं उगाया जाता है । मैं बताना चाहूँगी कि पिछले साल जहां चावल का दाम 4000 रुपये प्रति क्वविंटल बेचा गया था । इस साल वही चावल आधे से भी कम 2000 रुपये प्रति क्वविंटल से 2500 रुपये प्रति क्वविंटल में बिक रहा है । जिससे कि किसानों का लगाया गया मूलधन भी नहीं निकल पाया है और सरकार दावा करती है कि हम किसानों की आय दोगुनी कर रहे हैं । किसानों को उचित दाम न मिलने के कारण उनके ऊपर कर्जा अधिक बढ़ गया है जिसके कारण किसान आत्महत्या करने में मजबूर हो रहा है । अतः मेरी सरकार से गुजारिश है कि किसानों का कर्ज माफ किया जाए ।

श्री हरेन्द्र सिंह मलिक (मुजफ़्फ़रनगर) :मुजफ्फरनगर और शामली को राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र में सम्मिलित किये जाने के निर्णय से छोटे और मझोले व्यापारियों और किसानो समेत वहां के नागरिको पर प्रतिकूल प्रभाव पड़ रहा है| मुज़फ्फरनगर शामली समेत इन हिस्सों को राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र में लाये जाने से वहाँ अनावश्यक पाबंदिया लगा दी गयी है इससे किसानो के ट्रेक्टर, छोटे वाहन चालकों और छोटे छोटे उद्योगों कल-कारखानों पर अनावश्यक NCR के प्रतिबन्ध और रुकावटें लागू हो जाती है| किसानो के ट्रैक्टर, अन्य कृषि सम्बन्धी यंत्र तथा अन्य डीजल वाहनों पर भी ऐसे प्रतिबन्ध और भारी जुर्माने से उनके रोज़ी रोजगार का नुक्सान भी हो रहा है जबकि यह क्षेत्र दिल्ली से 100 किलोमीटर से भी ज्यादा दूर है । अत: मै सरकार से यह मांग करता हूँ कि मेरे क्षेत्र के निवासियों पर लागू इन पाबंदियो से हम सभी परेशान है । अत: इन परेशानियों को ध्यान में रखते हुए कृपया मुज़फ्फरनगर और शामली को राष्ट्रीय राजधानी क्षेत्र से बाहर करवाने की कृपा करें ।
records.ls|LS18_S4_1981:
Need to recognize Gangasagar Mela observed in Sagar Island, West Bengal as a National Mela-Laid

SHRIMATI JUNE MALIAH (MEDINIPUR): According to mythological, archaeological and historical evidences, Gangasagar Mela is the largest and oldest annual religious congregation of our country. It has been held at Sagar Island continuously for the last three millennia. It is a place on Sunderban delta where river Ganga meets the sea and a small temple with holy sage Kapil Muni, sage Bhagirath and the Ganga exists. The legend is associated with the story of King Bhagirath who performed penance and brought the sacred river Ganga from heaven to earth to free the souls of his ancestors, 60,000 sons of King Sagar, who were cursed by Maharishi Kapil Muni and turned to ashes. River-goddess Ganga descended here making Gangasagar a revered place to worship, perform rituals and seek spiritual solace. It is said that on Makar Sakranti, the Ganga reached the sage's 'Ashram' (hermitage) at Sagardweep and the condemned were liberated. Every year, in mid-January, on the occasion of Makar Sankranti, millions of Hindu devotees from all over India and abroad assemble at the Sagar Island. It is believed that a holy dip in the confluence of the Ganga and the Bay of Bengal will lead to atonement for earthly sins and the achievement of Moksha or salvation. Thus, the event has deep-rooted mythological and astrological significance, with this Mela itself together with Kapil Muni and the Sagar Island having been mentioned in the ancient Indian epics such the Ramayana, the Mahabharata and Kalidasa Raghuvamsham. As it is totally isolated from the mainland, all pilgrims are bound to cross the river Muriganga to reach the island, making it the only pilgrimage in India, which is accessible solely through waterways. There is urgent need for a bridge over Muriganga, for which detailed project report (DPR) has been completed by state Government at an estimated cost of Rs. 1500 crore. Intangible Cultural Heritage of India National Inventory can refer to "Social practices, rituals and festive events", making Gangasagar Mela eligible to be included in the list of National Melas like the festivals such as Deepavali, Chhat Puja and Kumbh Mela. Hence, I am seeking attention of Government of India to recognize Gangasagar Mela as a national Mela/a fair of national importance and placement of fund for this purpose.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1982:
Need to take comprehensive measures to address the losses on account of transmission and distribution of electricity in the country-Laid

DR. T. SUMATHY ALIAS THAMIZHACHI THANGAPANDIAN (CHENNAI SOUTH): Transmission & Distribution (T&D) losses in the country is the major reason for the shortage of power in the country. According to the Government report, India's T&D losses have been over 20 percent of generation, which is more than twice the world average. If only the government reduces the T&D losses the power supply will see the brighter side. Tamil Nadu is one of the top industrial states in the country and its power supply and demand alongwith the per capita consumption too is on higher side. According to the Load Generation Balance Report(LGBR) of the Southern Regional Power Committee(SRPC), TN's peak demand in April is expected to be 20600MW, against the availability of 21,488MW, resulting in a surplus of 985MW. But, in the evening, the requirement would be 20,700MW as against the availability of 16,003 MW, and leading to a deficit of 4,697MW. Steps are being taken by the Government of Tamil Nadu to ensure uninterrupted supply. Ahead of summer, the TNEB and TANGEDCO officials have identified overloading issues in 6,536 transformers across the state, of which, 407 have already been fixed. 48 new sub-stations have been installed to strengthen the power grid along with the proposal to commission 20 power substations throughout Tamil Nadu to provide an uninterrupted power supply. TANGEDCO is getting loans from REC Limited and Power Finance Corporation Ltd., to enhance power infrastructure at a rate of interest about 12.5%. The Government of India has been requested for reducing the interest to 9%. Therefore, I urge the Union Government to take all necessary steps to reduce the T & D losses in the country to less than 10%. Also I request the Union Government to provide adequate financial support to develop state of art power infrastructure in Tamil Nadu with a reduced rate of interest.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1983:
Need to set up a Post Office Passport Seva Kendra in Periyar Nagar area of North Chennai Parliamentary Constituency, Tamil Nadu-Laid

DR. KALANIDHI VEERASWAMY (CHENNAI NORTH): North Chennai, which includes densely populated areas such as Periyar Nagar, has seen significant growth in both residential and commercial sectors in recent years. Despite this, the residents of these areas are forced to travel long distances to the nearest passport office or regional passport office, which is inconvenient, costly, and time-consuming. The establishment of a Post Office Passport Seva Kendra (POPSK) in Periyar Nagar will significantly reduce the burden on local residents, especially in terms of transportation and time spent traveling to distant locations. Currently, the nearest POPSK is located far from the Periyar Nagar area. With the rapid urbanization and increasing number of passport applications, it is imperative that a passport service center is set up in this area. It is not uncommon for residents of North Chennai to face long waiting periods or have to travel long distances to reach an appointment at the nearest passport center. Being a representative of North Chennai Parliamentary Constituency, I have requested vide my letters dated 10.08.2024, 08.09.2024 & 19.01.2025 but no action has been taken so far. Therefore, I urge the Union Minister to open a Post Office Passport Seva Kendra in Periyar Nagar area of North Chennai Constituency Parliamentary Constituency as soon as possible.
records.ls|LS18_S4_1984:
Need to relocate the Jonnada toll gate at the bypass road near Modavalasa-Chelluru in Andhra Pradesh-Laid

SHRI APPALANAIDU KALISETTI (VIZIANAGARAM): I would like to draw the attention the Hon?ble Minister of Road Transport and Highways to a pressing issue concerning the Vizag-Raipur Highway (NH-43). This vital highway, along with the four-lane bypass road from Modavalasa to Gotlam on the outskirts of Vizianagaram, was envisioned to enhance regional connectivity, boost economic activity, and streamline freight movement across North Andhra and beyond. However, the placement of a toll gate at Jonnada, located between Vizianagaram and Visakhapatnam cities, undermines these objectives. This toll gate, instead of being located on the bypass or the Vizag-Raipur Highway, has been placed on a route heavily used by local commuters traveling between Vizianagaram and Visakhapatnam. Thousands of daily commuters, who neither use the bypass nor benefit directly from the highway infrastructure, are now being unfairly burdened with toll fees. I urge the Hon?ble Minister to revisit the toll placement policies and initiate a review of this matter. Corrective measures such as relocating the Jonnada tollgate to the bypass road near Modavalasa-Chelluru, where it rightfully belongs, would ensure fairness, equity, and public convenience. Let us reaffirm our commitment to creating infrastructure that serves the people efficiently and justly.

श्री सुधाकर सिंह (बक्सर) : मैं सरकार का ध्यान एक महत्वपूर्ण विषय की ओर आकर्षित करना चाहता हूँ । जैसा कि बोधगया को भगवान बुद्ध की ज्ञान स्थली के रूप में विकसित किया गया है और उसे अंतरराष्ट्रीय धार्मिक पर्यटन स्थल के रूप में मान्यता प्राप्त हुई है, उसी प्रकार बक्सर, जो कि प्रभु श्रीराम की ज्ञान स्थली रही है, को भी धार्मिक पर्यटन सर्किट में शामिल किया जाना चाहिए । बक्सर का ऐतिहासिक और धार्मिक महत्व अत्यंत व्यापक है । यही वह स्थान है जहां महर्षि विश्वामित्र ने भगवान श्रीराम और लक्ष्मण को दिव्य अस्त्र-शस्त्रों की शिक्षा दी थी । यह पवित्र भूमि करोड़ों हिंदुओं की आस्था से जुड़ी हुई है, लेकिन इसके बावजूद आज तक इसे धार्मिक पर्यटन के रूप में विकसित करने की दिशा में कोई ठोस प्रयास नहीं किया गया है । अतः, मैं सरकार से आग्रह करता हूँ कि बक्सर को आधिकारिक रूप से धार्मिक पर्यटन सर्किट में शामिल किया जाए और यहाँ के ऐतिहासिक स्थलों का समुचित विकास किया जाए ।यह न केवल सांस्कृतिक धरोहर को संरक्षित करने का कार्य करेगा, बल्कि इससे स्थानीय अर्थव्यवस्था को भी बढ़ावा मिलेगा और रोजगार के नए अवसर सृजित होंगे । अतः, सरकार इस दिशा में शीघ्र आवश्यक कदम उठाए ।

श्री चंदन चौहान (बिजनौर) : मैं सरकार का ध्यान हस्तिनापुर के एतिहासिक और पौराणिक महत्त्व की ओर आकर्षित करना चाहता हूँ । हस्तिनापुर, जो महाभारत काल में कौरवों की राजधानी थी, भारतीय संस्कृति और इतिहास में एक महत्वपूर्ण स्थान रखती है । यहाँ कई प्राचीन मंदिर, आश्रम और अन्य धार्मिक स्थल स्थित हैं जो इसे एक प्रमुख तीर्थस्थल बनाते हैं । 

हस्तिनापुर में स्थित प्रमुख स्थानों में पांडेश्वर मंदिर, कर्णेश्वर मंदिर, द्रोणाचार्य आश्रम और जैन धर्म के महत्वपूर्ण तीर्थ स्थल शामिल हैं । इन स्थलों का धार्मिक और सांस्कृतिक महत्त्व अत्यधिक है और यहाँ देशभर में श्रद्धालु एवं पर्यटक आते हैं ।

श्री हनुमान बेनीवाल (नागौर) : मैं माननीय जल शक्ति मंत्री जी को रावी- व्यास नदी के जल में पंजाब द्वारा राजस्थान के शेष हिस्सेदारी 0.60 एम.ए.एफ. पानी देने की मांग के संबंध में अवगत करवाना चाहता हूं कि दिनांक 31.12.1981 को पंजाब, हरियाणा व राजस्थान के मुख्यमंत्रियों के मध्य रावी-व्यास नदियों के आधिक्य जल के बंटवारे के बारे में एक समझौता हुआ जिसके अनुसार रावी-व्यास नदियों के आधिक्य जल में से राजस्थान के लिए भी उसके हिस्से का जल निर्धारित किया गया व समझौते के कुछ वर्षो बाद राजस्थान अपने हिस्से का पूर्ण जल उपयोग करने की स्थिति में हो गया और राजस्थान सरकार द्वारा भाखड़ा व्यास प्रबंधन मंडल, भारत सरकार तथा पंजाब सरकार को कई बार प्रतिवेदन भी दिए और पंजाब सरकार जब राजस्थान को उसके हिस्से का पानी नहीं देने के उद्देश्य से पंजाब समझौता समाप्ति अधिनियम 2014 लेकर आई तब भारत सरकार द्वारा भेजे गए इस विषय का परीक्षण करके माननीय सर्वोच्चय न्यायालय नें पंजाब सरकार द्वारा लाये गए अधिनियम को संवैधानिक प्रावधानों के अनुसार सही नहीं बताया और कहा कि 1981 के समझौते को पंजाब निरस्त नहीं कर सकता इसलिए केंद्र सरकार राजस्थान को उसके हिस्से का शेष जल शीघ्र् दिलवाने हेतु हस्तक्षेप करें ।
